## Definition of Done

Tick each item, or write "n/a" next to it with a reason.

### Functional

- [ ] All acceptance criteria are met
- [ ] Happy path and error paths are verified
- [ ] No regression in existing features
- [ ] Errors are understandable and handled correctly
- [ ] No incomplete feature is exposed as stable

### Code quality

- [ ] Code is formatted and linting passes
- [ ] No unused imports or dead code
- [ ] Responsibilities are properly separated
- [ ] No unjustified duplication
- [ ] New dependencies are justified and documented
- [ ] No premature abstraction

### Testing

- [ ] Unit tests added
- [ ] Integration tests added where needed
- [ ] Regression tests for fixed bugs
- [ ] CI passes
- [ ] Edge cases are tested
- [ ] Coverage targets are met

### Security and privacy

- [ ] No hard-coded credentials
- [ ] No sensitive data exposed in logs
- [ ] Inputs are validated
- [ ] Minimum necessary permissions
- [ ] Dependency scanning passes
- [ ] Threat model updated when needed

### Accessibility

- [ ] No information conveyed by colour only
- [ ] Keyboard interaction verified
- [ ] Output works in non-interactive terminals
- [ ] Text and machine-readable output verified
- [ ] Manual accessibility checks documented

### Documentation and delivery

- [ ] README updated when needed
- [ ] Architecture documentation updated
- [ ] Changelog updated
- [ ] Known limitations documented
- [ ] Pull request reviewed
- [ ] Acceptance criteria verified with evidence

AI coding agents: also include the completion report described in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/alestormoody/mcp-doctor/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#mandatory-completion-report).
